topic: vertical bounce and average normal force
statement: A rubber ball of mass m is released from rest from a height h_1 above a horizontal floor and falls straight down under gravity. Upon striking the floor, the ball remains in contact with the floor for a time interval t_c, during which the upward normal force exerted by the floor varies with time, and then rebounds straight up to a maximum height h_2. In a uniform gravitational field of acceleration magnitude g, find the magnitude of the average normal force exerted by the floor on the ball during the contact interval t_c.

h_1.desc: initial drop height above the floor

h_2.desc: maximum rebound height above the floor

t_c.desc: duration of contact with the floor

topic: time-varying force pulse followed by kinetic friction
statement: A block of mass m is initially at rest on a frictionless horizontal track. A horizontal pushing force is applied to the block; the magnitude of this force starts at zero, increases linearly with time to a peak value F_m over a time interval t_1, and then decreases linearly back to zero over a subsequent time interval t_2. Immediately after the force drops back to zero, the block enters a rough horizontal section of the track where the coefficient of kinetic friction between the block and the surface is mu_k. In a uniform gravitational field of acceleration magnitude g, find the distance the block slides along the rough section before coming to rest.

F_m.desc: peak magnitude of the horizontal pushing force

t_1.desc: time interval during which the force increases linearly

t_2.desc: time interval during which the force decreases linearly

mu_k.desc: coefficient of kinetic friction on the rough section
